Class MavenWrapper

java.lang.Object
network.ike.plugin.ws.MavenWrapper
public final class MavenWrapper extends Object
Shared generator for the three Maven Wrapper files that every workspace needs at the root:
  • .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties
  • mvnw (POSIX launcher — must be LF; executable bit set)
  • mvnw.cmd (Windows launcher — must be CRLF on Windows; see .gitattributes *.cmd text eol=crlf rule)

Used by ws:scaffold-init when scaffolding a new workspace, and by ScaffoldConventionReconciler's mvnw-standard step (run as part of ws:scaffold-publish) when any of the three files is missing from an existing workspace.

All methods are file-level idempotent: they unconditionally write the file at the given path. Callers are responsible for the "install only if missing" check — see writeMissingFiles(Path, String).

  • Method Details

    • writeMissingFiles

      public static int writeMissingFiles(Path wsDir, String mavenVersion) throws IOException
      Install any of the three wrapper files that are missing from the given workspace directory. Never overwrites an existing file — the user may have pinned a specific maven.version in maven-wrapper.properties or customized the launcher scripts.
      Parameters:
      wsDir - workspace root
      mavenVersion - Maven version to write into maven-wrapper.properties when creating it
      Returns:
      the number of files created (0 when all three already exist)
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing any of the files fails

    • readPinnedVersion

      public static String readPinnedVersion(Path wsDir) throws IOException
      Read maven.version from an existing .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties, or return null if the file does not exist or the property is missing.

      Used by the mvnw-standard upgrade step to preserve a user's pinned Maven version when regenerating a missing launcher script next to an existing properties file.

      Parameters:
      wsDir - workspace root
      Returns:
      the pinned Maven version, or null when not pinned
      Throws:
      IOException - if the properties file exists but cannot be read

    • writePropertiesFile

      public static void writePropertiesFile(Path propsFile, String mavenVersion) throws IOException
      Write maven-wrapper.properties with the canonical distribution URL for the given version. Creates the parent directory as needed.
      Parameters:
      propsFile - target path (typically .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties)
      mavenVersion - Maven version (e.g. 4.0.0-rc-5)
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing fails

    • writeMvnwScript

      public static void writeMvnwScript(Path mvnw) throws IOException
      Write the POSIX mvnw launcher script and mark it executable. The script reads maven.version and distributionUrl from .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties at runtime and downloads Maven on first use.
      Parameters:
      mvnw - target path (typically mvnw at workspace root)
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing fails

    • writeMvnwCmdScript

      public static void writeMvnwCmdScript(Path mvnwCmd) throws IOException
      Write the Windows mvnw.cmd launcher script. The workspace .gitattributes *.cmd text eol=crlf rule is what keeps this file usable on Windows after checkout — without it, cmd.exe chokes on LF line endings (IKE-Network/ike-issues#189).
      Parameters:
      mvnwCmd - target path (typically mvnw.cmd at workspace root)
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing fails
